summary.text: Bill Chumley is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 35 who has served since 2010 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a business owner and farmer from the Spartanburg area.

paragraphs.text: Bill Chumley is a deacon who owns four businesses around the Spartanburg area: Chumley Enterprises, a landscaping business; Southern Shade Nursery; Reidville Products International; and the home improvement hardware manufacturer Drainbox.
According to Ballotpedia, he holds seven patents and three federal trademarks.
Chumley is a native of Reidville, South Carolina, and launched his first campaign for the House on September 23, 2009.
He assumed office in 2010 and was assigned to the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee for 2025-2026.
The Republican primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
Chumley and his wife, Faye, have two grown sons and three grandchildren.
